newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tanayong PCL closes US$80 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Tanayong PCL closes US$80 mln loan.

text.p: Tanayong PCL's US$80 million transferable loan certificate facility has been closed, Hwa Kay Thai Holdings said Wednesday.
Hwa Kay Thai has a 31 percent interest in Tanayang.
The loan was over 2.2 times over-subscribed but was scaled back to US$80 million.
Proceeds will be used for repayment of a Thai baht denominated bridging facility previously taken out to finance the investment by Tanayong in Bangkok Mass Transit System PCL.
The one-year loan is extendible and pays a return of 250 basis points over the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate.
Schroder International Merchant Bankers Ltd is the arranger.
KLB Asia Finance is the co-arranger and lead underwriter.
Korean Merchant Banking Corp and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China are co-arrangers and underwriters.
Boram Bank, Daehan Investment Banking Corp, Housing and Commercial Bank, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and Tong Yang Merchant Bank are lead managers.
KLB Asia Finance, Kumho Merchant Bank, Bank of China and Korea Merchant Banking Corp are co-lead managers.

Central Banking Corp, Dah An Commercial Bank, Hanwha Merchant Bank, Fubon Commercial Bank, KDLC Lease & Finance Ltd. Kwantung Provincial Bank, Kyongnam Bank, Samsam Merchant Bank, Chung Chong Bank, Donghwa Bank, Dongnam Finance HK, Hanmi Leasing & Finance HK, Industrial Bank of Korea, Kexim Asia, Korea Leasing HK, Pusan Bank, Ssangyong Merchant Banking Corp, Cho Hung Leasing & Finance (HK), Schroder International Merchant Bankers Ltd and Shanghai Commercial & Savings Bank are managers.
